# appgatesdp_tag (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Read-Only

- `color_code` (Number) The color code of the tag. Default will be random color.
- 1: Light Green
- 2: Green
- 3: Indigo
- 4: Deep Purple
- 5: Yellow
- 6: Lime
- 7: Light Blue
- 8: Blue
- 9: Amber
- 10: Orange
- 11: Cyan
- 12: Teal
- 13: Deep Orange
- 14: Red
- 15: Gray
- 16: Brown
- 17: Pink
- 18: Purple
- 19: Blue Gray
- 20: Near Black
- `color_name` (String) The name associated with the color code.
- `created` (String) Create date.
- `linked_occurrences` (Number) The number of entities linked via this Tag.
- `linked_occurrences_by_entity_type` (String) The number of utilizing this Tag as a link group by entity link type. JSON encoded value; use jsonencode() and jsondecode().
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the tag is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `tagged_occurrences` (Number) The number of entities tagged with this Tag.
- `tagged_occurrences_by_entity_type` (String) The number of entities tagged with this Tag grouped by entity type. JSON encoded value; use jsonencode() and jsondecode().
- `updated` (String) Last update date.
